title: ColaPri: a Starvation-Free, Class-Oriented Load-Adaptive Priority Scheduler for Cloud Task Scheduling (CloudSim Plus) — replication package
description: Replication package for the ColaPri paper: a weighted-fair cloud task scheduler with per-class weights, a provable bounded-waiting (no-starvation) guarantee and load-adaptive activation, implemented as a CloudletScheduler for CloudSim Plus 8.5.7. Includes the scheduler, seven baseline schedulers (FCFS, SJF, strict priority, priority+aging, equal-weight WFQ, DFPO, and start-time fair queueing with ColaPri's own weights as the classical weighted-fair control), four task-to-VM mapping policies, all six experiment harnesses (EXP-A..F), the captured result logs behind every table in the paper, figure-generation scripts, the bundled PlanetLab, Bitbrains and Materna trace subsets, and SHA-256 checksums plus provenance for the third-party traces that cannot be redistributed (Alibaba, Azure). All simulated metrics are seed-deterministic and reproduce bit-identically. This work has been granted by the Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades (MICIU) AEI/10.13039/501100011033 under contract PID2023-146193OB-I00.
